docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $1,500.00 FILED BY MEHDI PARHIZKARI AS TO DEFENDANT MOHAMMAND AMIN ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR JUL-01-1994 AT 08:00 AM IN DEPT 02
